title: Common-stage cones and distinguished triangles
statement:
Let $f=[M,u]:(E,K)\to(F,L)$ be a morphism of the finite-stage pair category
$\mathcal P_T$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-stage-pair-category], represented over the finite field
$M\supset E,F$, so that $u:T_{M/E}K\to T_{M/F}L$ is a morphism of $\mathcal C_M(T)=\Dbc(T,M)$
[def-weil-pbc-rational-category], $T_{M/E}$, $T_{M/F}$ being the scalar-extension functors
[prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. Choose in the triangulated category $\mathcal C_M(T)$
[def-weil-triangulated-category, lem-weil-linear-scalar-localization-triangulated] a distinguished cone triangle
$$
 T_{M/E}K\xrightarrow{u}T_{M/F}L
 \xrightarrow{i_u}C(u)\xrightarrow{p_u}(T_{M/E}K)[1].
$$
Its image in $\mathcal P_T$ is the triangle [def-weil-pbc-triangles-with-shift], for the shift
$(E,K)[1]=(E,K[1])$ of $\mathcal P_T$ [prop-weil-pbc-common-stage-calculus],
$$
 (E,K)\xrightarrow{f}(F,L)\xrightarrow{[M,i_u]}(M,C(u))
 \xrightarrow{[M,\sigma_{M/E,K}^{-1}\circ p_u]}(E,K[1])=(E,K)[1],
$$
with cone object $(M,C(u))$, second arrow represented over $M$ by
$i_u:T_{M/F}L\to T_{M/M}C(u)=C(u)$, and third arrow represented over $M$ by
$$
 \sigma_{M/E,K}^{-1}\circ p_u:
 T_{M/M}C(u)=C(u)\longrightarrow T_{M/E}(K[1]),
$$
where $T_{M/M}=\operatorname{id}$ and $\sigma_{M/E,K}:T_{M/E}(K[1])\xrightarrow{\sim}(T_{M/E}K)[1]$ is the shift
comparison of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. Such a triangle is a *common-stage cone triangle*.
A triangle in $\mathcal P_T$ is distinguished if it is isomorphic, as a triangle
[def-weil-pbc-triangles-with-shift], to a common-stage cone triangle.

note:
*Source note:* no Stacks Project entry states this construction: the
blueprint adds the common-stage cone triangles of the pair category,
together with the shift comparisons of
[prop-weil-pbc-common-stage-calculus]. The axioms to be met are Stacks':
Derived Categories, Definition 13.3.1 ([Tag
0144](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0144), triangle and morphism of
triangles for an additive auto-equivalence $[1]$) and Definition 13.3.2
([Tag 0145](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0145), triangulated
category: TR1--TR4, TR4 being the octahedral axiom), both fetched and
quoted, and the pattern "distinguished means isomorphic to a triangle coming
from a given category" is the one used in Proposition 13.5.6 ([Tag
05R6](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/05R6)) for a localization
$S^{-1}\mathcal D$. Difference: Stacks fixes one additive category, its
shift and its set of distinguished triangles, while here the triangles are
generated by the cone triangles of the finite stages of a filtered pair
category; the ledger's verified derived-category entries (08TC, 07KC, 0BK6,
0BK7, 070M) likewise concern a fixed derived category.

mathlib_searches.results: none: Mathlib has no triangulated structure on a filtered 2-colimit of triangulated categories

Pretriangulated.lean (the class with its distinguished triangles), Localization/Triangulated.lean (triangulated structure on a localization: distinguished triangles are those isomorphic to images, the pattern of Stacks 05R6), Opposite/, Quotient.lean; nothing for a category of pairs (finite stage, object) with Hom a directed colimit

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against the master blueprint node and the slopmaster2 sketch (31_proper_base_change.tex, definition after the pair-shift proposition; 42_qbarl_triangulated_colimit.tex Definitions pair-cone and stagewise-triangle): they agree. Made the statement explicit without changing its meaning: the first arrow of the image triangle is f itself, the target of the third arrow is (E,K)[1]=(E,K[1]) for the shift of prop-weil-pbc-common-stage-calculus, and the representatives of the second and third arrows are read through T_{M/M}=id (as in 42_qbarl...tex). Named every notion as a statement dependency: the pair category P_T, the finite-stage category C_M(T)=D^b_c(T,M) and its triangulated structure (def-weil-pbc-rational-category, def-weil-triangulated-category, lem-weil-linear-scalar-localization-triangulated, the latter being where the shift and distinguished triangles of a rationalization are defined, as in the reviewed def-weil-rationalization-karoubi), the scalar extensions T_{M/E}, T_{M/M}=id and shift comparisons sigma (prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension), the shift of P_T (prop-weil-pbc-common-stage-calculus), and the notions triangle / isomorphism of triangles in a category with shift, a new Mathlib leaf def-weil-pbc-triangles-with-shift (Pretriangulated.Triangle, Stacks Tag 0144). Mathlib has no such pair construction (searches recorded).
